name: Hungary, National Assembly election

markets.question: Will TISZA – Respect and Freedom Party (TISZA) win the most seats in the next Hungarian parliamentary election?
Will Fidesz–KDNP win the most seats in the next Hungarian parliamentary election?
Will the next Prime Minister of Hungary be Péter Magyar?
Will the next Prime Minister of Hungary be Viktor Orbán?
Yes if TISZA wins the most seats in the 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election; a seat tie goes to the party entering government, then to vote share. (Kalshi KXHUNGARYPARLIPARTY-26APR12-TISZ)
Yes if Fidesz-KDNP wins the most seats in the 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election; a seat tie goes to the party entering government, then to vote share. (Kalshi KXHUNGARYPARLIPARTY-26APR12-FIDE)
Yes if Péter Magyar is the first person formally installed as Prime Minister through government formation after the 2026 election, before 1 May 2027. (Kalshi KXNEXTHUNGARYPM-26MAY01-PMAG)
Yes if Viktor Orbán is the first person formally installed as Prime Minister through government formation after the 2026 election, before 1 May 2027. (Kalshi KXNEXTHUNGARYPM-26MAY01-VORB)
Will Tisza win the most national list votes in the 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election?
Will Fidesz–KDNP win the most national list votes in the 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election?
Will Tisza win at least 130 seats?
Will Tisza win 130+ seats in the Hungarian National Assembly in this election?
Yes if Tisza wins more than 130 seats (at least one more than that number). (Kalshi KXTISZASEATS-26APR12-A130)
Will Tisza win at least 120 seats?
Yes if Tisza wins more than 120 seats (at least one more than that number). (Kalshi KXTISZASEATS-26APR12-A120)

notes: Units are the 106 single-member districts; 'counted' is the share of polling stations processed (seats race) or of the expected two-way list vote counted, incl. postal ballots (list race).
Share and raw are Tisza's share of the Tisza + Fidesz-KDNP vote. Map prior = the 2022 joint opposition's two-way share, mapped onto the 2024 district map by polling station.

The count is replayed from the 40 official publications of election night (every 10 min from 20:00 CEST, last at 06:00 CEST); each is used from its publication time. Timeline and map cover poll close (19:00 CEST) to 08:00 CEST; later publications (postal and envelope ballots, to 7 May) are scored in the stats but not drawn.
Official final (NVI, 7 May): Tisza 141 seats, Fidesz-KDNP 52; Tisza 57.94% of the two-way list vote (margin 14.67 pts of all party-list votes), 60.08% of the two-way district vote; turnout 78.99%.
P for seat and margin markets comes from joint simulation of all districts and the list vote through the seat law (D'Hondt with compensation votes); the next-PM markets are priced as 'most seats'.

Evidence: not pre-registered: settings frozen in configs/hu2026_v1.toml at 2026-10-28T18:59Z (sha256 6fec9912...) from the 2022 count only (9 Internet Archive copies of official night publications, 2018 prior); before the freeze the 2026 market resolutions, the 02:05 CEST national list summary and one district row had been seen while checking the feed; one scoring run on the 2026 count at 19:01:53Z, before the config was committed or registered; no setting changed afterwards

kalshi = Kalshi P(candidate a) from 1-minute candles: bid/ask midpoint when the spread is at most 10¢, else the last trade; YES = b markets are inverted. Prices © Kalshi, shown as derived charts with credit.

Sensitivity (v2): uncertainty settings re-chosen from the 2022 and 2018 nights (list: also 2014) by one common rule written down before it was run; chosen after the result was known, so it is not a forecast test. v1 (2022 night only) remains the headline. 2018 and 2014 count orders are simulated from the official polling-station results (no timeline was archived).

sensitivity.label: v2: settings from the 2022 and 2018 nights (district) and the 2022, 2018 and 2014 nights (list) (chosen after the result was known)

sensitivities.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
sensitivities.note: Instead of one value for how wrong the early count can be, the model is run with each value the earlier nights needed (districts: 2022 and 2018; national list: 2022, 2018 and 2014; the 2018 and 2014 count orders are simulated), the draws mixed with equal weights; the 2026 count chose nothing, but the idea was adopted after the result was known.
